details: Renewed clashes between the US and Iran have negatively impacted the cryptocurrency market, pushing Bitcoin below the $73,000 mark and triggering significant liquidations exceeding $247 million across the network. This geopolitical uncertainty, combined with substantial outflows from US spot Bitcoin ETFs, has intensified market fear. Crypto investors are now closely watching the upcoming US Non-Farm Payrolls report for potential market direction.
title: Geopolitical Tensions & ETF Outflows Drive Bitcoin Below $73K

details: US stock markets commenced June at record highs, driven by sustained earnings momentum. However, analysts indicate that significant challenges loom, including ongoing assessments of oil supply dynamics from the Middle East and their potential impact on inflation, as well as questions surrounding the long-term sustainability of the artificial intelligence (AI) rally.
title: Wall Street Hits Record Highs as June Begins, Major Tests Ahead
